items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jack Lesberg taking Arvell Shaw's place in Louie Bellson's band. The interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a working relationship with Lesberg.

ctx.x: There's jazz all over the world. You have the Maori people.

Every theatre we went in the brought 'em in world there for Louie/there was standing room only. And we got so tired from working, but it's a happy tiredness because we knew along with Louie we knew that we were liked everywhere we went and at one time Joe Darensbourg left and Eddie Shu took his place. That was the only people that left. Let's see, now, Arvell Shaw left for a while, too and Jack Lesberg took his place.
But I guess it was really a grind that time. I mean it was much more of a grind than the first time you were with Louie back in the '40s.
